definition: The logical and stylistic consistency of a generated text, measuring whether ideas flow sensibly and the output reads as a unified whole.
details: Coherence is one of several qualitative dimensions (alongside fluency, relevance, and faithfulness) commonly assessed in both human and automated evaluation of generated text.
story: Imagine a driving test that every new model has to pass before it is allowed on the road. Think of it this way: The logical and stylistic consistency of a generated text, measuring whether ideas flow sensibly and the output reads as a unified whole. And here is the clever part: Coherence is one of several qualitative dimensions (alongside fluency, relevance, and faithfulness) commonly assessed in both human and automated evaluation of generated text. It is the exam that keeps everyone honest. And that, done honestly, is Coherence.
